title: Group
summary: A group captures reversible composition with an identity.

content.plain: A group captures reversible composition with an identity.
content.exact: A group (G,·) has associativity, an identity e, and for every g an inverse g⁻¹; closure is part of ·:G×G→G.
content.example: Integers under addition form a group.
content.caveat: Commutativity is an extra condition, not part of the group definition.
